reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 33. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 2. Of 38 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 36 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

posts.text: Thank you to every Texan who let me hone my Capitol tour guide skills over the past four years. https://t.co/X5tDrMJwmR

To our veterans: Thank you for everything you've done for our nation. May God bless you and your families.

Happy Veterans Day 🇺🇸 https://t.co/O5DCKUU08J
Back in Washington on the House floor fighting to reduce the financial burden on our disabled veterans. https://t.co/8yl8Bogmnw

51 years young.

Happy birthday to my brother, Marcus! https://t.co/5RP5gtMfE5
Happy Election Day! Make your voice heard 🇺🇸 https://t.co/aPvrrz2TsN

Toured the TS Lone Star State at the @TAMU Maritime Academy in Galveston this week.

The state-of-the-art National Security Multi-Mission Vessel can train up to 600 cadets at sea simultaneously. https://t.co/flBZHNOWXB

First responders answer the call for our communities without hesitation.

On National First Responders Day, we thank our firefighters, police officers, EMTs, and dispatchers for their service. https://t.co/OTJeJTiqyg
Great things happening at Texas A&M improving brain health and combating PTSD. https://t.co/MgniucsIXJ
American innovation, made in Conroe. https://t.co/m9FWHwuL5g

Sailors aboard the future USS John F. Kennedy 🇺🇸

God bless our service members and our nation. https://t.co/ThI4mFIxFY

October is Law Enforcement Appreciation Month in Texas.

If you see a police officer, thank them for all they do protecting our communities. https://t.co/uA97gahuZz
251 years of the @USNavy 🇺🇸 https://t.co/4rpm41zBAi
Happy Columbus Day! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/Q3nUId5BWY

Thank you to every veteran who came out to our Veterans Resource Fair in Willis.

If you weren't able to make it and need help, my office is one call away: (281) 305-7890. https://t.co/tS3m7mzkGC

Power. Water. Internet.

The essentials for Texans, delivered by the hardworking team at MidSouth Electric Co-op.

Spent time with these folks in Montgomery talking about keeping it all running as our communities grow. https://t.co/V8BEs4HjUs

Three years ago today, Hamas carried out the deadliest attack on the Jewish people since the Holocaust.

We will never forget the lives taken that day, and we continue to pray for the families who still carry that loss. https://t.co/fn6afGOiSc

Nothing beats being back with the Conroe Chamber.

Always a pleasure to spend time with the business owners and community leaders who make Montgomery County such a great place to live and work. https://t.co/YCTOBn3B2r

🚨 Veterans — Mark Your Calendars: My office has a resource fair coming up that's designed just for you.

Join my team on Thursday, October 8th from 9am — 12pm in Willis to hear from veterans organizations and learn more about how we can assist you. https://t.co/6dfekYzcBS

20 years ago, Navy SEAL Michael Monsoor threw himself on a grenade in Ramadi to save the men beside him.

He chose his teammates over himself.

Remembering a true American hero today. https://t.co/tlbDPJG97T

The SAVES Act provides another tool in the toolbox for our vets when they return home.

It is a straightforward, bipartisan, and commonsense bill with a life-changing impact. https://t.co/1hzduTwu1d

Congratulations to @VenusAerospace on opening its new propulsion test stand at the Houston Spaceport.

The future of next-generation propulsion is being built right here in Texas. https://t.co/D9RKbn74zT
Great @ConcordiaSummit panel redefining how we treat the brain — proactively building peak performance for our workforce, our warfighters, and our society in the age of AI. https://t.co/VPLxi6zb1c

Flood mitigation in the Houston region has remained a top priority, and the House passage of the Water Resources Development Act of 2026 represents meaningful progress toward that goal.

I appreciate @RepFletcher's continued partnership on this effort. https://t.co/AWLvimgwUD

The Army's decision to deactivate the ECABs, including the 158th Aviation Regiment in Conroe, Texas, is an unacceptable gamble with our nation's readiness and puts the future of hundreds of soldiers and civilians in doubt. This decision cuts critical air assault, medical evacuation (MEDEVAC), and emergency response capabilities before a replacement is ready.

Our troops deserve better, and the communities that rely on these critical capabilities deserve better.

Congress is going to press forward to correct this mistake, restore these essential capabilities, and ensure our soldiers, their families, and our communities have the support and protection they deserve.

Spent this morning at the Montgomery County Veteran Flag Park 9/11 Remembrance event.

Never forget. https://t.co/ZQC7oBe5wF

On this day, we remember the 2,977 Americans who lost their lives and the first responders who died running into catastrophic danger for their fellow brothers and sisters.

America showed our true colors 25 years ago — how much we love each other.

9/11 is not just a day we remember, because we remember it every day. God bless America and thank you everyone for your patriotism.

Great visit to Oleon's Conroe facility, turning natural oils into esters and blends used across drilling fluids, lubricants, and more.

Proud to see this kind of domestic manufacturing and good-paying jobs growing right here at home. https://t.co/1F0829VyJM

100 suspected cartel drones downed in August.

We're using every tool at our disposal to keep Americans and their families safe. https://t.co/j9Flsthrn3
A lot to discuss in this week’s update. Let’s get into it. https://t.co/p7ypiPDwnU

September is National Suicide Prevention Month.

I encourage every American to check on the veterans, friends, family members, and neighbors in their lives. Sometimes a conversation, a phone call, or simply being there can make a difference.

If you or someone you know is struggling, please reach out and seek help. You do not have to fight this battle alone.

Edouard has strengthened overnight and a Hurricane Watch is now in effect for the northwest Gulf Coast, with landfall expected later today.

Finish preparations now: secure property, know your evacuation route, and follow local officials' guidance. https://t.co/5wMrv4nR9Y

Great visit to RoyOMartin's OSB facility in Corrigan.

This plant employs 200 Texans and is in the middle of a major expansion that will bring 123 more jobs to our community. https://t.co/X1JSjUjx3m

Visited the San Antonio Water System Brackish Groundwater Desalination Facility to learn how they are providing our state with 10 to 12 million gallons of safe, clean drinking water each day through an advanced reverse osmosis process. https://t.co/pOvjncfwKb

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
